info.title: Daily Funded API
info.description: Simulated trading platform API. Money: integer strings in minor units (…Minor). Prices/quantities: decimal strings.

isDefault.description: True for the Daily Funded default tenant

disabledModules.description: Client-dashboard modules switched off by the firm

superadmin.description: Daily Funded platform staff (can manage every firm)

twoFactorRequired.description: Admin routes refuse access until 2FA is enabled

fundedFailed30d.description: Funded accounts that failed in the last 30 days

sales30dMinor.description: Paid purchases, last 30 days (EUR minor units)

isTemplate.description: Platform template (read-only) vs. this firm’s own version

accounts.description: Accounts opened with this exact version

basedOnId.description: Template or own rule set to start from

activated.description: Has set a password and logged in at least once

ownerEmail.description: The firm admin; receives an email to set a password

email.description: New admin of the firm (replaces the current one)

superadmin.description: Create a Daily Funded superadmin instead of a firm admin

firmRole.description: Admin-panel role in the firm (null = trader only)

audience.description: client (default) = trading platform; admin = firm admin / Daily Funded staff (D91)

mfaRequired.description: Password OK; a 2FA code is required next

recoveryCodes.description: Shown once. Each code works one time.

isExample.description: Rule set has example values (not the final offer)

priceMinor.description: One-time fee, minor units of priceCurrency

productId.description: Catalogue product (exactly one of productId / quoteId)

acceptTerms.description: Terms, risk disclosure and refund policy accepted

offerCode.description: Personal offer code (e.g. from Daily Points)

isTestPayment.description: Test provider: no real money moves

hasRules.description: Account is governed by a rule set (challenge/funded)

usedMinor.description: Loss so far (limits) or progress (targets), minor units or days

floorEquityMinor.description: Equity level that breaches the rule

pnlMinor.description: Net trading result of the day (realized, commission, funding)

current.description: Days, count or minor units depending on the code (integer string)

kycRequired.description: KYC is required before the first payout (phase 9)

available.description: False when the rule set defines no payout/scaling terms

isExample.description: Values are examples, not the final offer

profitMinor.description: Closed profit in the current payout cycle

markPrice.description: Price the position would close at now

clientOrderId.description: Client-generated id, unique per account (optimistic UI + idempotency)

qty.description: Decimal string in base asset units

slPrice.description: Stop loss for the resulting position

tpPrice.description: Take profit for the resulting position

slPrice.description: Decimal string, or null to remove

tpPrice.description: Decimal string, or null to remove

qty.description: Partial close quantity (decimal string); omit to close fully

devTools.description: Development helpers are available (never in production)

refKey.description: Date, account id or reward id the entry belongs to

open24h.description: Price 24h ago (open of the 24h window), decimal string

accountId.description: Trading account the note is about

name.description: Public nickname or an anonymous label

returnBps.description: Return on the starting balance, basis points

you.description: Your best funded account, even if not public

payouts.description: Real payouts only (none before payouts launch)

holder.description: Public nickname or anonymous label (never a real name)

startMinuteOfDay.description: Local start time, minutes after midnight

testPayments.description: True while only test payments exist (no real money)

floorMinor.description: Equity at or below this ends the entry (static 10%)

returnBps.description: Return on the starting balance in bps

prizesMinor.description: Prize per place for the current pot

prizeMinor.description: Final prize, or the projected prize while the round runs

confirmAdult.description: Player confirms being 18 or older; must be true

paymentUrl.description: Where the player pays the entry fee

qty.description: Decimal string in base asset units

twoFactorRequired.description: True when 2FA must be set up before the panel opens

netEntryFeesMinor30d.description: Entry fees collected minus refunds, last 30 days

operatorRevenueMinor30d.description: Operator share of settled rounds, last 30 days

prizeMinor.description: Final prize, or the projected prize while the round runs

reference.description: Bank / PSP reference of the payout

setupUrl.description: One-time link (24 h) for the owner to set a password
